text:
maria_ops: heads up — multiple GPU nodes in us-west3 showing rapid memory pressure and repeated OOM evictions since 10:02 UTC. pods for batch-tasks are spiking mem to 95% and causing eviction storms. :warning:
sre_bot: ALERT: gpu_node_memory_pressure(us-west3) firing (threshold breach: >85% for 3m). Group: infra-gpu-autoscale. Link: https://monitoring.redwood.internal/alerts/8421
kevin_oncall: @maria_ops what's current impact on hosted API latency/400s? any customers hit?
maria_ops: 10–15% increase p50 latency on us-west3, a handful of requests returning 502 from warmed pods that OOMed. No org-wide 5xx spike yet, only regional. A customer (org-id: 9876) reported degraded responses to support.
jun_reliability: propose immediate traffic steering to us-central1 and eu-west1 for new requests. Suggest policy: route new sessions away from us-west3, drain-inflight with `--grace-period 120`. We can also spin up 8 nodes from reserved-burst pool.
kevin_oncall: agree. runbook step: set routing weight to 0 for us-west3 for model-serving route `redwood-gen` and split across us-central1 (70%) and eu-west1 (30%) to minimize cross-region egress. Notify support and customers.
maria_ops: executing routing change now: `redwood traffic set-weight --route redwood-gen --region us-west3 --weight 0`

```bash
# drain nodes after traffic shift
kubectl cordon node-gpu-32 -n infra
kubectl drain node-gpu-32 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120 -n infra
```

maria_ops: also launching 8 nodes from reserved-burst: `cloudctl compute instances create --pool reserved-burst --count 8 --gpu a100`
olivia_support: prepping customer comms. Draft status (for review):

```text
We are investigating elevated GPU memory pressure in us-west3 causing intermittent request failures for some customers. Traffic is being routed to other regions to preserve availability. We expect visible improvement within 15-25 minutes. If you are affected, please reply to this thread or open a ticket and we'll prioritize. — Redwood Infra Team
```

csm_amber: please flag top 5 paying customers in us-west3 for a targeted notice and offer handling via CSMs. I can coordinate outbound.
tim_product: quick cost note — cross-region fallback will increase egress and transient GPU cost from reserved-burst; estimate +$3k/hr if sustained. OK to run until stabilized?
kevin_oncall: yes, prioritize availability. Cost is acceptable for now. Keep me posted.
jun_reliability: routing change completed, draining nodes started. Observability: streaming metrics show p50 latency returning to baseline in us-west3 within 8 minutes after diversion.
maria_ops: support notified; Olivia to send the announced draft to status and update customers. I'll update once drained and we confirm no new OOMs. :white_check_mark:
